verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own documentation (llms.txt) says its file processing tools can be used from ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients, which indicates a first-party MCP server that agents can connect to. The evidence is one line in the docs index, with no setup or tool-surface detail. Missing for 10: MCP server setup and endpoint documentation, list of exposed tools and auth method, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use CloudConvert file processing tools from ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP clients.
